displayName: Unverferth Blu-Jet SubTiller II / SubTiller 4 In-Line Ripper

source.note: blu-jet-tillage-subtiller-in-line-rippers-mar.-2022.pdf. Blu-Jet is Unverferth Mfg. Co.'s tillage/applicator brand. Feature-comparison table gives shank-count and frame options but no per-width weight or working-width table, so recorded as a range-only family. The dedicated Subtiller2/Subtiller4 operator's manuals (Subtiller2 A66840100 and Higher.pdf, Subtiller4 A66840100 and Higher.pdf) were checked and contain no additional dimensional data.

displayName: Unverferth Blu-Jet TrackMaster II / TrenchMaster Track Closers

source.note: blu-jet-tillage-track-closers.pdf (doc code BJTRENCH02512005M4, (c) 2020 Unverferth Manufacturing Co.). Clean spec table on p.4 for both models. For pivot-irrigation tire-track and drainage-tile-trench repair/closing, not general tillage - filed under Disks per this library's countField (discs) convention, matching the Summers 3RT Track Remover precedent.

constants.discs: 22in concave discs, self-cleaning teardrop cutouts, mounted on heavy-duty 6-bolt hubs
constants.guideConeOption: Manual-adjust or hydraulically controlled, keeps implement on track

variants.note: 4-bar conversion kit available, extends working width to 72in by adding a pair of concave discs to the rear bar

displayName: Unverferth Blu-Jet Legacy All-Terrain Injection Toolbar

source.note: LEGACY.pdf, Assembly and Operators Manual, manual no. 0605010, Rev. 2-19-18, published by Thurston Manufacturing Company (Thurston, NE) - Blu-Jet's original maker before Unverferth acquired the brand in 2019 (see manufacturer-lineage/blu-jet). General specs on p.143 give a model range (40-52ft) but no per-width weight table; the actual row-count breakdown (15/16/17/18/19/20/21 rows at 30in spacing, plus a 24-row/20in-spacing variant) was cross-referenced from parts-catalog pages (pp.112-119) listing meter-assembly part numbers per row count, and working widths were derived from rows x spacing - not stated directly as a dimensions table. No weight figure exists anywhere in this 261-page manual for any configuration. Categorized under Strip Till (row-spaced injection toolbar with coulters) rather than Disks, unlike the disc-based TrackMaster II/TrenchMaster in this same file - function differs (liquid/anhydrous injection, not disc tillage).
